case_source_text.IK-112400:L127:restored-v2: The tenant opposed the claim of the landlord on both the grounds. He denied the allegation of sub-letting. He also contended that the landlord's requirement for his occupation was not bonafide. The tenant's plea was that the portion of the premises in his occupation was sufficient for his purpose. The Rent Controller accepted the plea of the tenant that there was no subletting. He also accepted his plea that the requirement of the landlord for his occupation was not bona fide.

case_source_text.IK-188721101:L81:restored-v2: 4. Respondent in support of his case examined himself as RW-1 and his brother Sh. Bhagwan Dass, the alleged sub-lessee, as RW-2. Both the witnesses deposed that Sh. Bhagwan Dass was working as an employee and drawing a salary of Rs. 10,000/- per month. The fact of Sh. Bhagwan Dass operating the shop and being in possession of key thereof was admitted. No proof of any other employee was produced. Salary vouchers of payment of salary to Sh. Bhagwan Dass were also not proved.
case_source_text.IK-188721101:L83:restored-v2: 5. Trial Court by the impugned judgment took the view that the fact of sub tenancy was not established. Trial court held that it was only a privilege or a licence by the tenant in favour of his brother to use the premises, which licence or privilege could be terminated at the sweet will and pleasure of respondent. Therefore, the arrangement did not amount to assignment or parting with the possession.

findings.old: 依赖原审许可判断预测驳回，缺少充分上诉效力限定。
findings.new: opposition.response直接加入the appellate court must respect the trial court factual finding。给定法源未提供这种必须遵从的上诉审查规则，且与gaps中目标接受未决有张力。

case_source_text.IK-188721101:L83:restored-v2: 5. Trial Court by the impugned judgment took the view that the fact of sub tenancy was not established. Trial court held that it was only a privilege or a licence by the tenant in favour of his brother to use the premises, which licence or privilege could be terminated at the sweet will and pleasure of respondent. Therefore, the arrangement did not amount to assignment or parting with the possession.
case_source_text.IK-188721101:L84:restored-v2: Further, it was the trial court's view that Bhagwan Dass was not a stranger or outsider but a family member of the respondent, therefore, sub-letting cannot be inferred.

findings.new: opposition开始引用L80邻居与房东说法，属局部覆盖改善；但把回应建立在未经支持的工资认定和上诉必须遵从规则上。父亲、6号铺柜台及工资凭证缺口仍遗漏；没有将更多引用直接记净收益。
